exercises.question: Classify CO2 and CaO as acidic or basic oxides.
exercises.question_amharic: CO2 እና CaO አሲዳማ ወይም ቤዛዊ ኦክሳይድ መሆናቸውን ለይተው ያስቀምጡ።
exercises.correct_answer: CO2 is an acidic oxide; CaO is a basic oxide.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: CO2 አሲዳማ ኦክሳይድ ነው፤ CaO ቤዛዊ ኦክሳይድ ነው።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Carbon is a non-metal, so its oxide CO2 reacts with water to form carbonic acid.\n2. Calcium is a metal, so CaO reacts with water to form calcium hydroxide (base).
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Carbon is a non-metal, so its oxide CO2 reacts with water to form carbonic acid.\n2. Calcium is a metal, so CaO reacts with water to form calcium hydroxide (base).
exercises.formula_or_working: Non-metal oxides are acidic; metal oxides are basic.
